verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26128604 for Soony Interactive GmbH PO 4500318685 dated 2026-06-23. One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,000 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-07-27. Terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. There are no handwritten corrections or stamps.
red_flags: Delivery terms are internally inconsistent: EXW Boise is stated, yet freight, insurance and duties are said to be prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so the invoice may include freight charges the buyer did not expect.
The document says 'DDP is not agreed' while describing the Seller paying duties, which also conflicts with plain EXW.
The Qty column is not labelled as ordered or confirmed. It is recorded as quantity_confirmed. The unit of measure is not stated.
The document has no issue date of its own. Only the customer order date, 2026-06-23, is shown.
observations: Clean printed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or visible damage.
The description wraps over three lines in the table ('Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5').
The 'Confirmed' column holds a date, not a quantity.
The unit price is given without a total line value.
